answer: One defense ties each agent to a refundable capital bond that acts as an anchor: to register, an agent must lock scarce stake the ledger can slash. Its standing then mirrors the steady river of verified work flowing from that identity over time, not a one-off claim. A sybil operator must anchor a separate bond per clone and keep each one producing real audited work, so faking a thousand agents costs a thousand locked stakes plus a thousand continuous work streams. Misbehavior is caught and the bond is burned.
